items.title: Quick Start Guide
items.content: Welcome to Scladapp. This guide walks you through creating your school, verifying your email, choosing a plan, and getting your first academic session running.

blocks.text: Welcome to Scladapp. This guide walks you through creating your school, verifying your email, choosing a plan, and getting your first academic session running.

steps.desc: Click Get Started on the homepage. Enter your school details, admin account, and choose a subscription plan.

blocks.text: Click Get Started on the homepage. Enter your school details, admin account, and choose a subscription plan.

steps.desc: A one-time code (OTP) is sent to your admin email during setup. Enter it to confirm your address before completing registration.

blocks.text: A one-time code (OTP) is sent to your admin email during setup. Enter it to confirm your address before completing registration.

steps.desc: Upload your school logo (optional), agree to the terms, and finish setup. You are logged in automatically when setup succeeds.

blocks.text: Upload your school logo (optional), agree to the terms, and finish setup. You are logged in automatically when setup succeeds.

steps.desc: From the admin dashboard, add staff members, then enroll students manually. There is no bulk CSV import.

blocks.text: From the admin dashboard, add staff members, then enroll students manually. There is no bulk CSV import.

steps.desc: Set up your academic session, add terms (subsessions), create classes, and assign subjects and teachers.

blocks.text: Set up your academic session, add terms (subsessions), create classes, and assign subjects and teachers.

items.callout: New schools get a free trial period. After that, a paid subscription is required to keep creating and editing data.

items.title: Login & Passwords
items.content: Scladapp supports admin, staff/teacher, and student logins. Each user signs in with email and password from the school login page.

steps.desc: Go to your school's login page and enter your email and password. Admins, staff, and students all use the same login form.

blocks.text: Go to your school's login page and enter your email and password. Admins, staff, and students all use the same login form.

steps.desc: If an account has no password yet, you will be prompted to create one using the set-password link sent to your email.

blocks.text: If an account has no password yet, you will be prompted to create one using the set-password link sent to your email.

steps.desc: Use Forgot Password on the login page. A reset link is emailed to you. Links expire after use.

blocks.text: Use Forgot Password on the login page. A reset link is emailed to you. Links expire after use.

steps.desc: Staff members who are also sub-admins can access both the staff portal and admin features after login.

blocks.text: Staff members who are also sub-admins can access both the staff portal and admin features after login.

items.callout: Keep login credentials secure. Admins can resend invite emails to staff and students from their profile pages.

blocks.text: Scladapp supports admin, staff/teacher, and student logins. Each user signs in with email and password from the school login page.

items.title: Subscription & Plans
items.content: Every school runs on a subscription plan. Plans control sub-admin limits and file storage. Students and staff are unlimited on all plans.

steps.desc: See available plans on the Pricing page or under Settings → Subscriptions in your admin dashboard.

blocks.text: See available plans on the Pricing page or under Settings → Subscriptions in your admin dashboard.

steps.desc: Choose a billing cycle (monthly, quarterly, or yearly) and pay via Paystack to activate or extend your subscription.

blocks.text: Choose a billing cycle (monthly, quarterly, or yearly) and pay via Paystack to activate or extend your subscription.

steps.desc: The subscription dashboard shows sub-admin and storage usage against your plan limits.

blocks.text: The subscription dashboard shows sub-admin and storage usage against your plan limits.

steps.desc: You can cancel from Settings → Subscriptions. Access continues until the current billing period ends.

blocks.text: You can cancel from Settings → Subscriptions. Access continues until the current billing period ends.

items.callout: When a subscription expires, your data stays safe and viewable, but creating or editing records is blocked until you renew. Support tickets and feedback remain available.

blocks.text: Every school runs on a subscription plan. Plans control sub-admin limits and file storage. Students and staff are unlimited on all plans.

items.title: Adding Students
items.content: Students are added manually, one at a time. Each student receives a unique ID and a secure portal login. You can also admit a student using an existing student ID from another school.

steps.desc: From the admin dashboard, open Students in the sidebar.

blocks.text: From the admin dashboard, open Students in the sidebar.

steps.desc: Click Add Student and fill in personal details, upload a profile photo if needed, and save.

blocks.text: Click Add Student and fill in personal details, upload a profile photo if needed, and save.

steps.desc: Use Enroll to assign the student to a class and arm for the active session and term.

blocks.text: Use Enroll to assign the student to a class and arm for the active session and term.

steps.desc: Use Resend Invite to email portal login details to the student or guardian.

blocks.text: Use Resend Invite to email portal login details to the student or guardian.

steps.desc: If a student already has a Scladapp student ID, use Admissions to enroll them into your school without re-entering all details.

blocks.text: If a student already has a Scladapp student ID, use Admissions to enroll them into your school without re-entering all details.

items.callout: There is no bulk CSV import. Students must be added individually or admitted by existing student ID.

blocks.text: Students are added manually, one at a time. Each student receives a unique ID and a secure portal login. You can also admit a student using an existing student ID from another school.

items.title: Guardians & Admissions
items.content: Link parents and guardians to students, and manage admission records when students join or transfer.

steps.desc: From a student's profile, add guardian contact details including phone and email.

blocks.text: From a student's profile, add guardian contact details including phone and email.

steps.desc: Mark one guardian as primary for official communications.

blocks.text: Mark one guardian as primary for official communications.

steps.desc: Use Admissions to register a new enrollment record for a student joining your school.

blocks.text: Use Admissions to register a new enrollment record for a student joining your school.

steps.desc: Each student's admission history shows past enrollments and class assignments across sessions.

blocks.text: Each student's admission history shows past enrollments and class assignments across sessions.

items.callout: Guardian details are stored per student and can be updated at any time by an admin.

blocks.text: Link parents and guardians to students, and manage admission records when students join or transfer.

items.title: Managing Staff
items.content: Manage teaching and non-teaching staff from one place. Staff receive portal credentials and can be promoted to sub-admin roles.

steps.desc: Click Staff in the admin sidebar to see all staff members.

blocks.text: Click Staff in the admin sidebar to see all staff members.

steps.desc: Click Add Staff, fill in personal details, role, and upload a photo. Login credentials are generated automatically.

blocks.text: Click Add Staff, fill in personal details, role, and upload a photo. Login credentials are generated automatically.

steps.desc: If a staff member did not receive their login email, use Resend Invite from their profile.

blocks.text: If a staff member did not receive their login email, use Resend Invite from their profile.

steps.desc: Create a sub-admin from an existing staff member. Your plan limits how many sub-admins you can have.

blocks.text: Create a sub-admin from an existing staff member. Your plan limits how many sub-admins you can have.

steps.desc: Deactivate a staff record to revoke portal access without deleting their history.

blocks.text: Deactivate a staff record to revoke portal access without deleting their history.

items.callout: Sub-admin count is limited by your plan. Students and staff headcount are unlimited on all plans.

blocks.text: Manage teaching and non-teaching staff from one place. Staff receive portal credentials and can be promoted to sub-admin roles.

items.title: Teachers & Subject Assignment
items.content: Teachers are staff members with teaching assignments. Link teachers to subjects and classes so they can enter scores and mark attendance.

steps.desc: Assign the teacher role to a staff member from the Teachers section.

blocks.text: Assign the teacher role to a staff member from the Teachers section.

steps.desc: Link subjects to teachers for the current session. A teacher can teach multiple subjects across classes.

blocks.text: Link subjects to teachers for the current session. A teacher can teach multiple subjects across classes.

steps.desc: Use Headmaster/Class Teacher assignment to designate who manages a class arm's attendance and remarks.

steps.desc: See past teaching assignments when sessions change or teachers move between classes.

blocks.text: See past teaching assignments when sessions change or teachers move between classes.

blocks.text: Teachers are staff members with teaching assignments. Link teachers to subjects and classes so they can enter scores and mark attendance.

items.title: Class & Session Setup
items.content: Sessions and terms (subsessions) define your academic calendar. Classes organize students; subjects are linked to classes for the active term.

steps.desc: Go to Sessions and add a new academic year with start and end dates.

blocks.text: Go to Sessions and add a new academic year with start and end dates.

steps.desc: Within the session, create subsessions (e.g. First Term, Second Term, Third Term).

blocks.text: Within the session, create subsessions (e.g. First Term, Second Term, Third Term).

steps.desc: Add class levels and arms (e.g. JSS1 A, JSS1 B) under Classes.

blocks.text: Add class levels and arms (e.g. JSS1 A, JSS1 B) under Classes.

steps.desc: For each class, assign the subjects taught during the active term.

blocks.text: For each class, assign the subjects taught during the active term.

steps.desc: Use the complete session wizard to set up sessions, terms, class teachers, and subject assignments in one flow.

blocks.text: Use the complete session wizard to set up sessions, terms, class teachers, and subject assignments in one flow.

items.callout: Only one session is typically active at a time. Switch the active session from Settings when a new year begins.

blocks.text: Sessions and terms (subsessions) define your academic calendar. Classes organize students; subjects are linked to classes for the active term.

items.title: Student Application Form
items.content: Accept new student applications online through a public form. Configure which fields to collect, review submissions, and admit applicants as enrolled students.

steps.desc: Go to Settings → Website. Turn on Accept new applications and copy the public application link to share with prospective families.

blocks.text: Go to Settings → Website. Turn on Accept new applications and copy the public application link to share with prospective families.

steps.desc: Open Configure fields to choose which sections and inputs appear on the form (personal details, guardians, documents, etc.). Required fields must be completed before submission.

blocks.text: Open Configure fields to choose which sections and inputs appear on the form (personal details, guardians, documents, etc.). Required fields must be completed before submission.

steps.desc: Open Applications in the sidebar to see all submissions. Filter by status, open a row to view full details, and unread applications are marked with a blue dot until opened.

blocks.text: Open Applications in the sidebar to see all submissions. Filter by status, open a row to view full details, and unread applications are marked with a blue dot until opened.

steps.desc: From an application detail panel, click Admit to open the Create New Student form pre-filled with the applicant's data. Saving the student marks the application as approved.

blocks.text: From an application detail panel, click Admit to open the Create New Student form pre-filled with the applicant's data. Saving the student marks the application as approved.

steps.desc: Grant sub-admins access under Admin permissions using the Applications module (read, create, edit, delete). Read access is required to view the Applications page.

blocks.text: Grant sub-admins access under Admin permissions using the Applications module (read, create, edit, delete). Read access is required to view the Applications page.

items.callout: The public form is available at /school/{schoolId}/apply. Turn off Accept new applications to stop new submissions without deleting existing records.
